summary.text: Daughter of Asopus to whom Zeus granted a home on the Assyrian shore and the virginity she craftily chose when the god promised to grant whatever her heart desired.

story.text: Apollonius tells that on the Assyrian shore Zeus himself gave a home to Sinope, daughter of Asopus, and granted her virginity, beguiled by his own promises; for he longed for her love and promised to grant whatever her heart's desire might be, and she in her craftiness asked of him virginity.
